title: torch.normal generate a cpu tensor even though I set default device is cuda
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```
import torch
import math

torch.set_default_device('cuda')
in_dim = 24
out_dim = 2        
xavier_stddev = math.sqrt(2.0 / (in_dim + out_dim))
W = torch.normal(0, xavier_stddev, size=(in_dim, out_dim), dtype=torch.float32)
print(W.device)
```
the result is cpu not cuda
